# Spaceship Logistics Analytics

> Logistics analytics platform over synthetic order operations data.

## Workspaces
- [Overview Workspace](/#overview): Operational KPIs, order volume trends, and delivery performance metrics.
- [Forecasts Workspace](/#forecasts): Known-SKU demand coverage forecasts with an adjustable 1–4 month horizon and visible planning buffer.

The natural-language assistant is optional and routes one validated operation through Workers AI; all returned analytics and forecast values are computed by the application. The forecast is a sparse-history demand-coverage baseline, not a trend model, confidence interval, or purchase order recommendation.
